name: Hellish Rebuke

casting_time.trigger: you take damage from a creature you can see within 60 feet of you

summary: Reaction when damaged: the attacker makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 Fire damage, half on a success.
text: Reaction, taken when a creature you can see within 60 feet of you deals damage to you. Green flames engulf that creature, which makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 Fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.
